name: Swift 2.0
what_it_is: Swift is a powerful and intuitive programming language for iOS apps that builds on the best of C and Objective-C, without the constraints of C compatibility. Swift adopts safe programming patterns and adds modern features to make programming easier, more flexible, and more fun. A Swift 3.0 roadmap was announced on the Swift blog on December 3, 2015. Swift 3.0 is the first major release developed in the open at Swift.org, with source code, a bug tracker, mailing lists, and regular development builds available for everyone.
